card.name: Noun right before a relative clause
card.fires_on: A noun or 'which' that ends a noun phrase and is followed by 'that' or 'which' or a modifier, such as 'second system that', 'toys that', 'of which'. Also fires on a few word-ending pieces like 'able' and 'ink'.

modes.label: Noun before 'that'
modes.description: A plural or object noun at the end of a phrase, followed by 'that' introducing a clause.
modes.example: clothes and<< toys>> that are donated or reused reduce your carbon

modes.label: 'which' after 'of'
modes.description: The word 'which' after a phrase like 'a modified version of' or 'the full value of'.
modes.example: a modified version of<< which>> is also available as a book, Bard

modes.label: Possessive or ordinal modifier
modes.description: A word like 'next' or 'later' after 'their' or 'its', ahead of a noun.

card.plain: It marks a spot where a noun is finished and a clause describing it is likely to follow.
